messages:
alex: Quick sync — Q3 runtime performance bets. We have a handful of customer asks (large-context low-latency from Acme, BankCorp wants deterministic latency for embeddings) and limited engineering bandwidth. I want us to pick top 3 investments and define launch criteria + owners. Candidate bets: kernel selection/scheduling, adaptive quant rollout, KV prefix cache + eviction policy, smarter batching heuristics. Need quick risk/impact notes and suggested canary criteria. @maria @sam @jason @priya

maria: +1. My vote is kernel selection + scheduling first. We get broad perf wins without model quality risk. Cheaper to implement in runtime.

sam: Quantization is huge for unit cost — we could cut token cost 2-3x on many models. But it requires evals per-model and has compatibility edge cases. If we do quant first we need strong quality regression gating.

jason: agree with maria for immediate latency SLO wins. But for Acme's 8k prompt use case KV cache + prefix caching reduces repeated compute for long chats — that might matter more for tail latency.

priya: Customer asks: Acme wants 95th percentile latency < 600ms for 8k prompt in hosted tier. BankCorp requires embeddings p99 < 200ms. Those are aggressive. We should map each bet to which customer requirement it moves.

alex: Good framing. Let's sketch launch criteria for each bet so PMs can sign off. Keep them minimal and measurable.

maria: Kernel scheduling launch criteria (proposal):
- measurable token/sec uplift on standard perf harness >= 20%
- no increase in median latency for short requests (<32 tokens) > 5%
- synthetic canary 1% of traffic for 48h with telemetry: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU util
- automated rollback if p99 latency increases > 10% or error rate > 0.2%

sam: Adaptive quant rollout criteria (proposal):
- per-model quality regression <= 0.5% on held-out eval set (and human review for top 20 models)
- cost/unit improvement >= 1.8x measured on production mix
- canary: start at 0.5% traffic, expand to 5% after 24h if metrics stable
- tooling: automatic fallback to fp16 if divergence detected in logits or embeddings

jason: KV prefix cache criteria (proposal):
- p95 latency improvement for long-context flows (>= 4k tokens) >= 25% for chat workload suite
- cache hit rate > 30% for demo customer workload (Acme test corpus)
- eviction policy default: LRU with TTL tunable per-customer
- rollout: staged across Dedicated pools first, then hosted

priya: Also need acceptance criteria from comms/legal for Private customers: deterministic cache behavior + docs. Add telemetry contract for audits.

alex: Nice. Now tradeoffs & blockers:
- kernels: needs HW profiler time and some low-level kernel authors — estimate 6w for MVP.
- quant: needs model-specific evaluator infra and human-in-the-loop checks — estimate 8-10w for safe rollout.
- KV cache: infra changes and per-customer config surface — estimate 4-6w but higher ops complexity.

maria: Dependencies: kernels depend on driver/kernel matrix and nightly benchmarks. Quant depends on eval infra + model owners. Cache depends on storage/eviction infra (eng-infra) + metrics.

sam: On experiments: we should measure three core metrics per canary: latency p50/p95/p99, cost per 1M tokens, and quality delta (automated eval score). If any triggers, auto-roll back.

jason: can we define the rollouts in code? e.g.:

```
canary_policy:
  initial_pct: 0.5
  step_pct: 2.5
  step_interval: 24h
  abort_on:
    - latency_p99_increase: 10%
    - error_rate: 0.2%
```

priya: +1 to that config. Also add a manual hold for legal for Private deployments.

alex: Good. Minor ask from product: pick top 3 now so PMs can resource-plan. My suggestion: 1) kernel selection + scheduler, 2) KV prefix cache (for long-context SLA wins), 3) adaptive quant (longer timeline). Does that ordering make sense?

maria: I can scope kernel MVP and owners.

sam: I'll own quant proof-of-concept and the eval harness.

jason: I'll take KV cache work with eng-infra help.

priya: I'll collate customer SLAs and create acceptance sign-off docs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — performance test cluster allocated for "perf-q3" starting 2034567900.

alex: Action items:
- maria: kernel MVP spec + 2-week micro-plan by Mon EOD (owner: maria)
- sam: quant eval harness PR + benchmark plan by Wed (owner: sam)
- jason: KV cache design doc + ops impact note by Thu (owner: jason)
- priya: SLA mapping doc for Acme/BankCorp + acceptance checklist by Fri (owner: priya)

maria: I'll include cost/impact numbers in the spec (expected tokens/sec uplift, engineering hours).

sam: I'll mock the regression gate dashboards in Grafana for the quant canary.

jason: I'll sync with eng-infra tomorrow about storage implications.

alex: Perfect. We'll reconvene next Tue for prioritization decisions and capacity match. Thanks team :thumbsup:
